comment: Validation oracles: the published specifications whose own examples are the Prism's test content. tools/oracle/gen.py fetches each source at its pinned SHA-256, takes its examples out mechanically (an example is kept only if every address in it is at a domain reserved for documentation, RFC 2606 and RFC 6761, so no real person's address enters the repository), and reads each one with a reference reader written to the source's own grammar. test/oracle/read.test.mjs then holds the Prism's reading (site/card.mjs readItem) to that reading, field by field. Nothing here is invented: a new kind of content is added by naming the specification it follows.

sources.title: RFC 5322 Internet Message Format, Appendix A
